# Verify rqlite capabilities

> **ID:** WI-2026-11-21-002 | **Status:** active | **Started:** 2026-11-21

**References:** [RFC-0001](../rfc/RFC-0001.md), [RFC-0001:C-DEPARTURE](../rfc/RFC-0001.md#rfc-0001c-departure), [RFC-0001:C-ODD-VOTERS](../rfc/RFC-0001.md#rfc-0001c-odd-voters), [RFC-0001:C-MANUAL-RECOVERY](../rfc/RFC-0001.md#rfc-0001c-manual-recovery), [RFC-0001:C-CONDITIONAL-WRITES](../rfc/RFC-0001.md#rfc-0001c-conditional-writes), [RFC-0001:C-APPROVED-LIST-TRUST](../rfc/RFC-0001.md#rfc-0001c-approved-list-trust), [ADR-0001](../adr/ADR-0001.md), [ADR-0002](../adr/ADR-0002.md), [ADR-0003](../adr/ADR-0003.md)

## Description

Prove with automated tests that rqlite provides every capability that [RFC-0001](../rfc/RFC-0001.md) and [ADR-0001](../adr/ADR-0001.md), [ADR-0002](../adr/ADR-0002.md) and [ADR-0003](../adr/ADR-0003.md) rely on, before any product code, and record a "capability → exists / how / limits" table. A missing capability reopens the affected clauses or ADRs (roadmap 2.1 gate).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] chore: A node changes between voter and non-voter at runtime.
- [ ] chore: Leadership is transferred to a chosen node.
- [ ] chore: Unreachable nodes are auto-removed, with one node (the Cloud Node) excluded.
- [ ] chore: Backup and restore work (`/db/backup`, `/boot`).
- [ ] chore: CDC is emitted, including with a new `service_id`.
- [ ] chore: A follower forwards writes to the Leader.
- [ ] chore: Each read call chooses its consistency level.
- [ ] chore: Approved-list changes apply by restarting `rqlited` one node at a time, Leader last, including with a single voter and with a machine that was off.
- [ ] chore: The capability table records exists / how / limits for every item above.
